entries.title: OpenAPI 3.1 fully aligns with JSON Schema 2020-12
entries.body: OpenAPI 3.1 adopts JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 as its schema vocabulary without modification; schemas are now directly validatable by standard validators (Ajv, jsonschema, networknt) with no translation layer.

entries.title: nullable removed in favor of type arrays
entries.body: OpenAPI 3.1 removes the proprietary nullable:true keyword from 3.0. Use type: ["string","null"] instead. Migration is a mechanical find/replace; leaving nullable:true in a 3.1 doc makes it invalid.

entries.title: exclusiveMinimum / exclusiveMaximum are numeric in 3.1
entries.body: OpenAPI 3.0 defined exclusiveMinimum/exclusiveMaximum as booleans modifying minimum/maximum. 3.1 restores the JSON Schema Draft 6+ meaning: numeric boundaries (exclusiveMinimum: 7).

entries.title: discriminator enables polymorphism
entries.body: The OAS base vocabulary adds discriminator to the Schema Object for polymorphism: it selects which schema a payload satisfies via propertyName (and optional mapping). discriminator is not part of stock JSON Schema.

entries.title: OpenAPI 3.0 $ref forbids siblings; 3.1 allows them
entries.body: OpenAPI 3.0 ignored sibling keywords next to $ref; JSON Schema (and 3.1) allows them. 3.1 aligning with JSON Schema means translation layers are no longer required for $ref.

entries.title: jsonSchemaDialect sets the default $schema
entries.body: The OpenAPI root object has a jsonSchemaDialect field setting the default $schema for all schemas; individual Schema Objects may also declare $schema and $id as in JSON Schema.

entries.title: integer is a JSON number without fraction
entries.body: OpenAPI 3.1 data types are based on JSON Schema 2020-12; integer is defined as a JSON number without fraction or exponent. format: int32/int64 refine ranges but do not change the underlying JSON type.

entries.title: example becomes examples in 3.1
entries.body: OpenAPI 3.1 replaces the singular schema-level example with the JSON Schema examples array. Media-type example(s) also move to examples. This is a mechanical migration from 3.0.

entries.title: OAS dialect adds a base vocabulary (discriminator, xml)
entries.body: The OAS Schema Object dialect (id https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/dialect/base) requires the OAS base vocabulary on top of JSON Schema 2020-12 vocabularies; xml and discriminator are OAS-specific keywords.

entries.title: Reference Object resolves by URI
entries.body: The Reference Object's $ref is a URI (RFC 3986); relative references resolve per JSON Reference rules. A Schema Object $ref pointing to a non-OAS JSON Schema resource MUST follow JSON Schema rules for that resource.
